info.title: Adeli API
info.summary: One REST API to publish, comment, message, and read analytics on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X, Bluesky, and LinkedIn.
info.description: Adeli maintains the developer app on every network, completes each platform's review, and manages OAuth and token refresh, so you hold one API key. Your first 3 connected accounts are free. Guides and examples: https://www.tryadeli.com/docs

post.description: Publish to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X, Bluesky, or LinkedIn. A LinkedIn post takes at most one of `image`, `images` (2–20 staged images), `video` (one staged MP4), or `document` (one staged PDF with a title), plus optional `mentions`. Instagram requests using only staged upload references are durably accepted with 202 and a status URL; legacy base64 or URL inputs remain synchronous during the compatibility window. Send `multipart/form-data` only for TikTok uploads on this shared endpoint.

post.description: Create short-lived, object-scoped S3 PUT descriptors. Upload each file with the returned headers unchanged, then pass its uploadId as upload_id when publishing. Name one `platform`, or several `platforms` to upload a file once and use it in a publication to all of them; each file must fit every listed platform's limits.

post.summary: Publish one post to several accounts
post.description: Shared `content` and `media` go to every target in `platforms`; a target's own `content`, `media`, and `options` (that platform's `createPost` fields) override them. Every target is validated as `createPost` would validate it, then the publication is accepted durably with 202 and a `statusUrl`. Poll `getPublication` until `status` is `published`, `partial`, or `failed`. Scheduling is not supported yet.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional stable key; a retry with the same key and body returns the original publication with 200, and a different body returns 409.

get.description: Without conversationKey, every message for the profile, account or platform, oldest first. With conversationKey (which requires accountId; 400 invalid_request otherwise), one conversation read from the history Adeli stores: the newest `limit` messages (default 50, at most 100) before `cursor`, oldest first within the page, and `nextCursor` toward older messages (null at the start of the conversation). Each message carries its conversationKey.

parameters.name: conversationKey
parameters.description: One conversation's messages: a message's conversationKey. Requires accountId. The response then holds the newest `limit` messages before `cursor`, oldest first, and `nextCursor`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, toward older messages. Requires conversationKey.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Messages per page with conversationKey, 1–100. Defaults to 50.

conversationKey.description: `<platform>:<counterparty id>` (an IGSID, a PSID, or a WhatsApp wa_id in digits), scoped to accountId: with accountId it identifies one conversation. Pass it to listMessages to read that conversation. Null when the counterparty is unknown; optional so clients built before it existed still type-check.

nextCursor.description: Present only when conversationKey is given: pass it as cursor for the next, older page; null when there are no older messages.

get.summary: Get an Instagram user who messaged the account
get.description: Reads someone who has messaged the Instagram account, live from Instagram: their username and name, and whether they follow the account (`isFollowing`). Instagram shares this only after the person has sent the account a message or tapped one of its buttons; before that it is 409 user_consent_required. An id Instagram does not recognise is 404 user_not_found. Not cached.

parameters.name: igsid
parameters.description: The person's Instagram-scoped user id (IGSID): `message.created` `from.id` or `message.postback` `senderId`.

isFollowing.description: Whether this person follows the connected account. Null when Instagram did not say.

isFollowedByAccount.description: Whether the connected account follows this person. Null when Instagram did not say.

post.description: Registers a URL for comment.created, message.postback and message.created events on one profile. Pass `platform` (`instagram`, `tiktok`, `facebook` or `whatsapp`) to receive one platform's events only; omit it to receive every supported platform. Each platform sends only some events: `comment.created` comes from Instagram and TikTok, `message.postback` from Instagram, and `message.created` (inbound direct messages) from Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp. A platform with an event it does not send is 422 unsupported_for_platform. The signing secret is returned only in this response.

platform.description: Receive events from this platform only. Omit to receive every supported platform. `message.postback` requires `instagram` or no platform; `comment.created` requires `instagram`, `tiktok` or no platform; `message.created` requires `instagram`, `facebook`, `whatsapp` or no platform.
